metadata.title: NASA-ISRO NISAR Seasonal Dance Timeline (Annual Astronomical Cycle)
metadata.studyArea: Great Rann of Kutch Basin, Gujarat, India

stops.title: JANUARY 18, 2026 • WINTER CRUST & GHOST OCEAN
stops.physicsExplanation: Dry halite salt crystals exhibit near-zero dielectric loss (ε" < 0.005). 24cm microwaves pass directly through the 15cm dry surface crust, imaging the buried 1819 Allah Bund fault scarp and reflecting off the subterranean ancient brine sea at 38cm depth.
stops.ecologicalSync: Desert foxes, jackals, and wild ungulates traverse the firm, bone-dry salt crust. Migratory waterfowl concentrate in southern coastal wetlands until the monsoon returns.

stops.title: JULY 12, 2026 • FIRST MONSOON TIDAL INGRESS
stops.physicsExplanation: Arabian Sea tidal surges and initial monsoon runoff enter through the western mudflats. Smooth specular water acts as a mirror, deflecting radar waves away into space (deep dark tones), contrasting against the rougher dry mud borders.
stops.ecologicalSync: Water begins wrapping around Khadir Island, starting the formation of the natural water moat that protects Flamingo City from desert foxes and jackals.

stops.title: AUGUST 29, 2026 • PEAK MONSOON INUNDATION SEA
stops.physicsExplanation: Over 7,500 km² of the basin floor is completely submerged under a contiguous saltwater sea. Calm open water produces an intense specular null (-18.09 dB average), completely penetrating dense monsoon storm clouds.
stops.ecologicalSync: Flamingo breeding reaches its zenith with 500,000+ chicks safely isolated on elevated mud mounds inside the deep moat.

stops.title: OCTOBER 28, 2026 • SAVANNA BLOOM & DRY HALITE CRUST
stops.physicsExplanation: Floodwaters evaporate under scorching post-monsoon heat, leaving millions of jagged hexagonal salt crystals. High cross-polarized HV backscatter (-22.10 dB) reveals dense sweet grasses blooming across the southern Banni savanna.
stops.ecologicalSync: Maldhari nomadic pastoralists guide 50,000+ Kankrej cattle onto rich Banni grassland pastures in an ancient seasonal waltz of human-nature harmony.
